cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 66% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.51% · WTI -4.62% · Brent -0.11% · NatGas -4.79%. 66% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.63%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.63%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -0.81%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +6.82%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +6.82%, WFRD +6.59%, GEV +4.36%, VRT +4.36%, BEP +3.68%. Laggards: MPC -1.79%, EOSE -1.79%, EQT -1.41%, ENPH -0.90%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
